fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat (2007 Yamaha SX230 jet boat) with trailer.
findings: Hull side gelcoat and gray graphic band look glossy with no visible chalking in the profile shot
Bow and cockpit vinyl seating looks clean and bright with no visible staining
Light scuffing and faint marks on the bow floor/footwell liner
Helm dash and gauges look clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Yamaha SX230 and it already looks well kept, with glossy hull sides and clean white seating. If you want it extra sharp for showings, we can come to you for a wash and wax plus a light interior touch-up, including the scuff marks on the bow floor. Would you like a quote?
